app.title: LingoReel
bar.entry.markEndNoStart: Mark the end and save (mark the start first)
bar.option.fill: Fill the subtitle while the actor speaks
bar.option.resetSync: Reset the sync of both subtitles
bar.tip.track: Click or drag to go somewhere else
bar.tip.translationLocked: The translation always shows in this study mode
diagnostics.stalled: connected, but the position does not move (frozen?)
dialog.exitNotSaved:
{reason}

What changed in this video since the last save (corrections, sync, passages, where you stopped) is not on the disk yet. Try again? If you cancel, the app closes without those changes.
edit.empty: The subtitle cannot be empty. Write something or press Esc to cancel.
edit.hint: Enter saves · Esc cancels · Shift+Enter breaks the line
error.association.failed: Could not change how Windows opens videos.
error.association.unavailable: This computer does not allow videos to be associated with LingoReel.
error.disk.denied: Windows did not let the app write there. Check that the file is not marked "Read-only" (in the file's Properties), that the folder allows writing and that an antivirus is not blocking LingoReel.
error.disk.full: The disk is full. Free some space, deleting files you do not use or emptying the Recycle Bin, and try again.
error.disk.inUse: Another program is using the file. Close that program and try again.
error.disk.readOnly: The disk is write-protected. Unlock it or choose another disk.
error.disk.tooLong: The file's path is too long for Windows. Use a folder with a shorter path.
error.disk.unavailable: The disk or folder is not available: it may have been removed, disconnected or renamed. Reconnect it and try again.
error.edit.noLine: There is no line in this subtitle now.
error.edit.notSelected: Choose a line first: click it with the video paused.
error.edit.playing: Pause the video to correct a subtitle.
error.edit.times: The end must come after the start, and the start cannot be before the video begins.
error.edit.tooLong: A line can have up to 2000 characters.
error.export.dialog: Could not open the window to save the file.
error.export.empty: This subtitle has no lines to export.
error.export.failed: Could not write the exported subtitle.
error.ffmpeg.notFFmpeg: That program is not a working FFmpeg. Choose ffmpeg.exe.
error.ffmpeg.slow: FFmpeg did not answer in time because the computer is busy. Try again in a moment.
error.install.failed: The installation did not finish. Try again or download it from the official site.
error.install.ffmpegUnavailable: Automatic installation is not available on this computer. Download FFmpeg from the official site (ffmpeg.org) and choose ffmpeg.exe in "Browse…".
error.install.unavailable: Automatic installation is not available on this computer. Use "Download from the official site".
error.karaoke.barColor: Karaoke mode: the bar's color is not valid.
error.karaoke.fillColor: Karaoke mode: the fill color is not valid.
error.karaoke.indicator: Karaoke mode: choose the bar or the countdown.
error.karaoke.previewColor: Karaoke mode: the preview color is not valid.
error.karaoke.repeat: Karaoke mode: repeating each line goes from 0 to {max} times.
error.karaoke.timing: Karaoke mode: the shortest gap goes from {gapMin} to {gapMax} s and the lead time from {leadMin} to {leadMax} s.
error.noResponse: The player did not answer the command.
error.notReady: The app's window is still opening. Try again in a moment.
error.notSupported: The player in use does not allow that.
error.panelWidth: The panel's width is out of range.
error.passage.duplicate: A passage with that name already exists.
error.passage.invalid: The passage must be at least 1 second long and end after it starts, inside the video.
error.passage.name: Give the passage a name of up to 80 characters.
error.passage.noneToSave: Start studying a passage before saving it.
error.passage.outside: This passage starts after the end of the video. Delete it or save it again.
error.passage.plan: Check the gap (0 to 5 s) and the goal of repetitions (0 to 99).
error.passage.readOnly: The passage was not saved: this video's corrections file cannot be written now (the panel tells why).
error.passage.time: Use hours, minutes and seconds, like 1:10:23 or 10:23.
error.passage.tooMany: This video already has too many saved passages. Delete one first.
error.player.missing: This player is no longer installed. Choose another one or install it again.
error.player.path: Choose the player's program: an .exe file.
error.player.unsupported: This player is not supported by LingoReel.
error.playerLost: The player closed or stopped responding, and the session ended.
error.profile.changed: The profile changed while you were editing. Open the settings again.
error.profile.exists: A profile with that name already exists.
error.profile.last: At least one profile must be kept.
error.profile.name: Give the profile a name of up to 60 characters, without spaces at the start or the end.
error.profile.switchWhileWatching: Stop the video before switching profiles.
error.project.notSaved: Could not write this video's corrections file.
error.project.resetFailed: Could not forget what was kept for this video.
error.project.resetWhileWatching: Stop the video before forgetting what was kept for it.
error.settings.hideDelay: Control bar: the time to hide goes from {min} to {max} s.
error.settings.noticeDuration: Notices on the video: the duration goes from {min} to {max} s.
error.settings.profile: Check the preferred languages and the preferred player.
error.settings.reveal: Choose how the translation key works.
error.settings.speed: Choose one of the speeds in the list.
error.settings.syncSteps: Sync steps: the step goes from {min} to {max} ms, and the step while holding goes from the step up to {fastMax} ms.
error.shortcut.windowOnly: That shortcut works in the film's window.
error.speechPack.busy: Another language is being downloaded. Wait for it to finish or cancel it.
error.speechPack.failed: The download did not finish. Check the internet and try again.
error.speechPack.notAsPublished: The file arrived other than published and was thrown away. Try again.
error.speechPack.notPublished: This file is not available to download yet. Try again in a newer version of the app.
error.speechPack.notRemoved: This language could not be removed.
error.start.display: Could not open the video's window with the subtitles. Try again; if it keeps happening, restart LingoReel.
error.start.failed: Could not start the session. Try again.
error.start.launch: {player} did not open in time. Click Watch to try again; if it keeps happening, close other {player} windows.
error.start.notFound: {player} was not found at {path}. Check the path in Settings › Player, or install it again.
error.start.subtitles: Could not read the chosen subtitles. Choose another subtitle or check its file.
error.startup:
LingoReel could not open. To ask for help, send this detail:

{reason}
error.subtitleFile.dialog: Could not open the window to choose a file.
error.subtitleFile.tooMany: This video already has {max} subtitle files added, the most it can have.
error.subtitleFile.unreadable: That file is not a subtitle the app can read (.srt, .ass, .ssa or .vtt).
error.thumbnails.notCleared: Could not delete the kept thumbnails.
error.track.loading: Wait for the subtitle that is loading.
error.track.sameAsOther: The other subtitle already shows that track.
error.track.unknown: That track is not a subtitle the app can read in this video.
error.unknownLanguage: The app does not speak that language.
error.video.busy: A video is playing. Stop it (Stop button) to open another one.
error.video.dialog: Could not open the window to choose a file.
error.video.notFound: The file {name} was not found. It may have been moved, renamed or deleted.
error.video.unreadable: The file {name} does not look like a video LingoReel can read: it may be damaged or incomplete.
error.video.unsupported: LingoReel does not open {extension} files. Use an .mkv, .mp4, .avi, .mov or .wmv video.
error.videoLayout: Could not place the video in the window.
error.welcome.language: Choose the language you speak and the one you want to study.
error.welcome.watching: End the video before opening the setup.
health.reconnecting: The player is not responding. Reconnecting…
health.stalled: The player seems frozen: the subtitles wait for it.
notice.mark.noStart: Mark the start of the passage first
notice.mark.tooShort: The end must come at least 1 s after the start
notice.practice.atEnd: End of the passage · Play to repeat
notice.practice.failed: The player did not respond to the passage.
passage.name: Passage {start}–{end}
player.benefit.potplayer: Fast and widely used on Windows, with good hardware acceleration.
player.benefit.vlc: The most popular player: it opens almost any format and is great if you already use it.
project.newerVersion: This video's corrections were written by a newer version of LingoReel. Nothing you change now is written to them: corrections, sync and passages last only until the video closes.
project.unreadable: This video's corrections file could not be read. What you change now will not be kept.
settings.file.damaged: The file {file} was damaged, so the app started with the defaults. Before writing your changes over it, the app keeps a copy of the file in the settings folder.
settings.file.newer: The file {file} was written by a newer version of the app. This version uses the defaults and writes nothing to it: changes last until you close the app.
settings.file.unreadable: Windows did not let the app read the file {file}. The app uses the defaults and writes nothing to it: changes last until you close the app.
settings.problem.accent: the accent color cannot be transparent
settings.problem.barThickness: the bar's thickness goes from {min} to {max}
settings.problem.countdownSize: the countdown's size goes from {min}% to {max}% of the subtitle
settings.problem.fontSize: the font size goes from {min} to {max}
settings.problem.hintSize: the hint's size goes from {min} to {max}
settings.problem.lineGap: the distance between the subtitles goes from 0 to {max} lines
settings.problem.lineSpacing: the line spacing goes from {min} to {max}
settings.problem.maxLines: the most lines go from {min} to {max}
settings.problem.maxWidth: the widest width goes from 1% to 100%
settings.problem.noticeWidth: the widest width goes from {min}% to 100%
settings.problem.outOfRange: one of the values is out of range
settings.problem.outlineWidth: the outline's thickness goes from 0 to {max}
settings.problem.padding: the background's margin goes from 0 to {max}
settings.problem.position: the position goes from 1% to 100% of the height
settings.problem.selectionRadius: the corners' rounding goes from 0 to {max}
settings.problem.shadowBlur: the shadow's blur goes from 0 to {max}
settings.problem.shadowOffset: the shadow's offset goes from −{max} to {max}
settings.problem.sizeMode: choose a fixed or a responsive size
settings.problem.textSize: the text size goes from {min}% to {max}%
shortcut.category.subtitle: Subtitle sync
shortcut.command.passageMarkEnd: Mark the end and save the passage
shortcut.command.passageMarkStart: Mark the start of the passage
shortcut.problem.aloneKey: The right Alt works alone, without Ctrl, Alt or Shift.
shortcut.problem.altShift: Alt+Shift switches the keyboard language in Windows. Choose another combination.
shortcut.problem.conflict: “{chord}” is already the shortcut for “{first}”. Choose another combination for “{second}”.
shortcut.problem.noKey: The main key is missing: hold the modifiers and press a key.
shortcut.problem.other: That key cannot be used as a shortcut.
shortcut.problem.reserved: That combination belongs to Windows itself. Choose another one.
shortcut.problem.tooManyKeys: Use three keys at most: up to two modifiers (Ctrl, Alt, Shift) and one key.
track.note.adjusted: The timing was adjusted by itself to match the video ({offset}).
track.note.candidate: Found in a subfolder; it could not be checked against this video.
track.note.heard: Matches the film's voice: the app listened to parts of the film to check.
track.note.noMatch: The timing does not match this video: it may be from another film or another version.
track.note.otherCut: It seems to be from another version of the film (extended or director's cut): it drifts out of sync at every scene.
track.note.unreadable: It cannot be used: a subtitle made of pictures, or in a format LingoReel does not read.
video.missingAndUnfit: There is no subtitle in {missing} in this video, and the subtitle in {unfit} the app found does not match it: it may be from another film or another version. Choose another one below, or put the right files in the video's folder and open it again.
video.missingLanguage: There is no subtitle in {language} in this video. Choose another one below, or put an .srt file in the video's folder and open it again.
video.missingLanguages: There is no subtitle in {first} or in {second} in this video. Choose another one below, or put an .srt file in the video's folder and open it again.
video.unfitLanguage: The subtitle in {language} the app found does not match this video: it may be from another film or another version. Choose another one below, or put the right file in the video's folder and open it again.
video.unfitLanguages: The subtitles in {first} and in {second} the app found do not match this video: they may be from another film or another version. Choose others below, or put the right files in the video's folder and open it again.
webview.contactAdmin: LingoReel needs Microsoft's WebView2. Ask this computer's administrator to install it.
webview.crashed: WebView2 stopped working and LingoReel needs to be opened again.
webview.downloadPage: LingoReel needs Microsoft's WebView2. Click OK to open the download page. Minimum version:
webview.failedToInstall: The WebView2 installation did not work. Try again.
webview.installationRequired: LingoReel needs Microsoft's WebView2. Click OK to download and install it; the installation runs quietly, so please wait a moment.
webview.invalidFixed: The WebView2 given is not valid. Check the minimum version and the WebView2 folder.
webview.updateRequired: Microsoft's WebView2 needs to be updated. Click OK to download and install it; the installation runs quietly, so please wait a moment.
